description: de Prevención de incendios de la Comunitat Valenciana is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.icv.gva.es. Seirbhís léirshamhlaithe léarscáileanna a bhaineann le cosc dóiteáin. Cuireann an tseirbhís seo, i measc seirbhísí eile, faisnéis ar fáil maidir leis na nithe seo a leanas:, Pointe Uisce, Pointí Dubha ar Bhóithre, Limistéir Balla Dóiteáin agus Criosanna Teorainn, faisnéis maidir le Páirceanna Nádúrtha agus pleananna áitiúla. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "СУП за противопожарна защита на Валенсианската общност" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ICV_CLAS:Medi ambient;Incendis, ICV_CLAS:Environment;Fire, ICV_CLAS:Medio ambiente;Incendios. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2018-01-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
